zh.name: 极简风 · 案例成果
zh.summary: 用案例图片建立认识，再结合关键数据，讲清做了什么、取得什么结果。
zh.useWhen: 出租屋改造、项目总结和活动成果。
zh.instructions: 提供单个案例的背景、原始照片、改动项、结果指标和适用条件。
zh.output: 一组可编辑的小红书图文，默认 3 页。

en.name: Minimal Case Outcome
en.summary: Show a case through comparable images, concrete changes, and a clearly defined outcome.
en.useWhen: Small-space makeovers, project results, and event recaps.
en.instructions: Add the real case photos, changes, measurable outcome, and constraints.
en.output: An editable Xiaohongshu carousel, typically three pages.
